note: How many arguments the ENGINE requires, for filters whose upstream spec understates it. Two ways the spec's `optional` flag lies: a LEADING optional in front of a required argument, which cannot be omitted positionally because the next argument slides into its slot; and a filter whose arguments are ALL marked optional that the engine nonetheless requires in full, so the declared-legal zero-argument call fails before the filter body runs. `codegen:filters` requires the first `minArgs` arguments of each filter listed here, synthesizing slots when the spec declares fewer. Regenerate with `tsx scripts/probe-filter-arity.ts` against a sandbox — it calls every filter with zero arguments and reads the required count out of the engine's own refusal.
